bait_content.title: Cache Index Sync Required
bait_content.body: The browser detected an out-of-date cache index after the previous session did not close cleanly. Some resources may appear stale or fail to load until the index is rebuilt. Running a quick sync will validate cached entries and purge corrupted records. Estimated time: 15–30 seconds.
